installation.notes: Canonical Google adapter. Gemini CLI consumer workflows migrated to Antigravity; legacy gemini adapter is an explicit alias.

repository_read.implementation: Antigravity custom-agent tool allowlists + PreToolUse workspace boundary guard

product_write.implementation: writer roles receive native file edit tools; PreToolUse blocks control-plane/external writes

control_plane_write_deny.implementation: PreToolUse denies writes to .aledevos/.agents/.git/AGENTS plus permission overlay defense-in-depth

arbitrary_shell_deny.implementation: only certified state roles receive run_command; PreToolUse allows only enumerated .aledevos node commands

canonical_gate.implementation: state roles invoke portable AleDevOS runtime through governed run_command

scope_prewrite.implementation: writer tool boundary + deterministic scope prepass; exact prewrite scope remains portable policy

external_directory.implementation: workspace-bound PreToolUse path guard; target preflight must prove hooks active on installed Antigravity version

network.implementation: network tools omitted/denied; permissions overlay blocks read_url/execute_url/mcp/unsandboxed; target preflight required

code_mode.implementation: no dangerously-skip-permissions projection; dynamic subagent definition denied; shell restricted to governed runtime commands

compaction.implementation: Antigravity persistent history plus portable ContextOS checkpoint/resume

structured_handoff.implementation: portable handoff contract + native custom subagents/invoke_subagent

context_budget.implementation: portable ContextOS generic profile until target telemetry is exact

preventive_transition.implementation: ContextOS pressure bands and verified checkpoint/resume

skill_registry.implementation: portable Skill System + native .agents/skills open-standard skills

visual_qa_runtime_checks.implementation: portable Visual QA P4 runtime audit

visual_qa_judge.implementation: custom visual-judge role + portable P5 semantic judge; target model must prove image observation

visual_qa_bounded_repair.implementation: frozen P5 bounded repair controller, max repairs=2

target_runtime_preflight.implementation: Antigravity certifier verifies CLI presence/version and flags known platform/hook prerequisites
